# the Rust qpsk_channel_select::pick_marker_channel and the dock's C++ cb_pick_marker_channel
# Rule: the LOWEST channel whose cluster clears min_clusters; when none clears it, the largest
# cluster, ties to the lowest; no channels -> none.
# Columns: <clusters: a,b,... or <empty>><TAB><min_clusters><TAB><expected position or none>.
# the live 4 s clip of 27.9.2026: L 7, R 8, both clear the floor -> L
# the committed 2 s fixture: L 3 below the floor, R 4 -> R
# none clears the floor -> the largest, ties to the lowest
# the operator floor (--qpsk-min-clusters) decides what "clears" means
